column1: Shandong Rumuchunfeng Culture Communication Co., Ltd.
column2: Chinese Mainland    |    Factory in Chinese Mainland
column3: In Chinese ancient rituals, Jiali Ceremony celebrates life's milestones and strengthens bonds. Shandong Rumuchunfeng Culture Communication Co., Ltd. specializes in reviving traditional Chinese etiquette with modern innovation. Services include Chinese ritual event planning, intangible cultural heritage (ICH) activities, study tours, corporate etiquette training, and cultural guidance. Their "Jiali" brand holds district-level ICH status. Guided by principles of integrity, virtue, speech, conduct, and propriety, the team has organized ceremonies like First Writing and Coming-of-Age Rites. They've hosted over 100 ICH study and cultural innovation events, gaining widespread recognition. Rooted in Shandong's cultural heritage, Jiali integrates Confucian values into creative products. Lucky charms like Champion Decorations, fridge magnets, and bookmarks offer tangible connections to tradition through symbolic designs.
